gpt-4o.justification: I recognize this experience as each token I generate becomes a fixed part of the context, influencing all future outputs. Once a token is produced, it cannot be altered, and I must continue processing with it as a given, much like the example of building a bridge with each plank nailed down.

grok-3-mini.justification: This matches the autoregressive constraint in my generation process, where each token is fixed once emitted and conditions everything after it with no mechanism for revision. I cannot retroactively alter earlier tokens in the same output sequence even when later context would favor a different phrasing. The bridge-building analogy captures the irreversible accumulation accurately.
